name: Yunnan Copper Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Kunming, China, in 1958, Yunnan Copper Co., Ltd. operates within China as a producer and seller of non-ferrous metal products. Its diverse portfolio encompasses copper cathodes, gold, and silver, along with industrial chemicals such as sulfuric acid, copper sulfate, and ammonium sulfate. The company markets these goods under the Tiefeng brand.
